# DonutStats HUD

DonutStats HUD is a lightweight client-side mod aimed at enhancing the experience of playing on  **DonutSMP** by providing an alternative scoreboard in the form of on-screen HUD elements.

The mod takes data from in-game scoreboard and presents it as modern HUD widgets. The main goal is to make this useful information more accessible while reducing visual clutter caused by the default sidebar system. It works only for  **DonutSMP** server and will automatically disable HUD functionality when run on any other server.

## Features

- Modern HUD widgets for Money, Shards, Kills, Deaths, Keyall, Playtime, Team, and Region/Ping  
- Clean and centered HUD design with customizable widget order  
- Ability to turn off the vanilla scoreboard  
- Option to adjust bossbar offset to avoid conflicts  
- Fully configurable in-game via [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) + [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config)  
- Targeted at specific server **DonutSMP**

## Configuration

Configuration options can be set in-game via Mod Menu. Alternatively, you can edit configuration file located at: `config/donutstats-hud.json`

Options:
- Turn on/off HUD display
- Hide vanilla scoreboard
- Adjust bossbar offset value
- Configure widget order

## Dependencies

To use this mod, you will require the following dependencies:

- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)  
- [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)  
- [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) + [Cloth Config](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) (for in-game configuration screen)
